test_load_npy_integral: test spdl.io.load_npy with integral dtypes uint8, uint16, int16, and int32 for zero-copy reconstruction
test_load_npy_float: test spdl.io.load_npy with float32 and float64 dtypes to verify zero-copy array reconstruction from bytes
test_load_npz: test spdl.io.load_npz to load uncompressed .npz archives containing multiple numpy arrays of various dtypes
test_load_npz_compressed: test spdl.io.load_npz to load DEFLATE-compressed .npz archives and verify all array contents match originals
test_parse_zip_error_handling: test spdl.io.load_npz error handling for invalid zip data including too-short input and missing EOCDR signature
